mainEntity.name: Can AI tell me whether my business idea has enough demand?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can help assess whether a niche appears crowded, underserved, or poorly differentiated, but it cannot prove demand from competitor presence alone. Combine competitor evidence with customer problems, search behavior, willingness-to-pay signals, existing alternatives, and a small validation test. Key factors include: - whether complaints reflect a solvable gap - how many customers share the problem - access to the audience - your ability to deliver a distinct outcome. Use an opportunity-research workflow to rank hypotheses and design a low-cost test. Avoid treating a polished AI report as evidence that customers will buy.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can help assess competitors, customer problems, alternatives, and possible gaps, but it cannot prove demand by itself. Pair desk research with direct customer conversations, a waitlist, preorders, a pilot, or another small test that reveals whether people will take meaningful action.
